notes.text: Drums Comp bus: compressor 'No Stressor', threshold -20dB, attack 20ms, release 50ms -- compressor parameters have no field in this format.

Instructions say to ignore 'not patched for this event' comments; all rows treated as normally patched channels with no stated socket, so channel-order patching (LCL then AES50-A overflow) applies to all of them.
reply: 'unassigned_inputs' left out once; read as an empty list: no row left out on purpose, so code builds every input-list row no channel names

critic_findings.message: Conventions specify patch order as drums, bass, guitars, keyboards, strings/brass, vocals, tracks, then speakers — the plan patches HOST (speech) at channel 30, ahead of the tracks block (31-38), reversing the required tracks-before-speakers order.

info.message: 'Magenta' is the desk's Pink (11): EG 1, EG 2, AC Guit 1, AC GUIT 2. The desk has no colour called 'Magenta'; Atoo used that name for 11 until the desk was asked, so it still resolves. Say 'Pink' to use the desk's own word
Main index set to 1 -- the plan left it out; decided by Atoo's fallback rule: the plan has one Main, so it is Main 1
info.fix: if that is the wrong strip, number it in the conventions ("Main 2", "Matrix 3") and rebuild

info.message: Matrix index set to 1 -- the plan left it out; decided by Atoo's fallback rule: its name, 'Matrix 1', states slot 1
info.fix: if that is the wrong strip, number it in the conventions ("Main 2", "Matrix 3") and rebuild

build_findings.message: channels numbered in the order the reply listed them: ch 1-38

LCL: the reply chose the group, code the next free socket in channel order -- Kick LCL 1, Snare LCL 2, HiHat LCL 3, Tom1 LCL 4, Tom2 LCL 5, Tom3 LCL 6, Tom4 LCL 7, OH L LCL 8, OH R LCL 9, Pads LCL 10, PERC 1 LCL 11, PERC2 LCL 12, BassDI LCL 13, BassMic LCL 14, EG 1 LCL 15, EG 2 LCL 16, AC Guit 1 LCL 17, AC GUIT 2 LCL 18, Keys 1 LCL 19, Keys 2 LCL 20, Horns 1 LCL 21, Horns 2 LCL 22, Strings 1 LCL 23, Strings 2 LCL 24
A: the reply chose the group, code the next free socket in channel order -- VOX 1 AES50-A 1, VOX 2 AES50-A 2, VOX 3 AES50-A 3, VOX 4 AES50-A 4, VOX 5 AES50-A 5, HOST AES50-A 6

USB: the reply chose the group, code the next free socket in channel order -- T DRUMS USB 1, T Bass USB 2, T Keys USB 3, T Elec Guit USB 4, T Ac Guit USB 5, T Strings USB 6, T VOX/FX USB 7, T Click/Guide USB 8

colour applied from the reply's category map by each input-list row's category: drums -> Red (12: Kick, Snare, HiHat, Tom1, Tom2, Tom3, Tom4, OH L, OH R, Pads, PERC 1, PERC2); bass -> Blue (2: BassDI, BassMic); guitars -> Magenta (4: EG 1, EG 2, AC Guit 1, AC GUIT 2); keys -> Cyan (2: Keys 1, Keys 2); horns -> Orange (2: Horns 1, Horns 2); strings -> Orange (2: Strings 1, Strings 2); vocals -> Green (5: VOX 1, VOX 2, VOX 3, VOX 4, VOX 5); speech -> Purple (1: HOST); tracks -> Yellow (8: T DRUMS, T Bass, T Keys, T Elec Guit, T Ac Guit, T Strings, T VOX/FX, T Click/Guide)
